title: The self as ultimate originator may be an enculturated confabulation

statements.text: Children are treated from the start as able to veto and to have done otherwise, and the self-model internalizes this before autobiographical memory begins. The adult conscious model of a self with ultimate origination and self-causation could be an enculturated post-hoc confabulation, a causal-inference illusion built into a model of the sociocultural niche.

sources.quote: could therefore be an enculturated post-hoc confabulation
We are embodied models of our early social environment.
